Comparable.description: What the cell digest hashes: every resolved value, the harness, the treatment, the catalog snapshots, the inputs and the plug-in environments of a run, each list sorted and without duplicates.

environments.$comment: Sorted by the text of the plug-in then the lock digest in code point order, without a repeated entry; the Rust reader refuses a list that is not.
environments.description: The plug-in environments, sorted by plug-in text and lock digest.

harness.description: The harness that ran the agent.

inputs.$comment: Sorted by kind then digest in code point order, without a repeated entry; the Rust reader refuses a list that is not.
inputs.description: The digests of the inputs, sorted by kind and digest.

snapshots.$comment: Sorted by kind then digest in code point order, without a repeated entry; the Rust reader refuses a list that is not.
snapshots.description: The digests of the catalog snapshots, sorted by kind and digest.

values.$comment: Sorted by path in code point order, without a repeated path; JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a list that is not.
values.description: Every resolved value by field path, sorted by path; a value without `value` was not recorded.

Deviation.description: A re-checked value that a forced resume accepted although it differed from the stored one.

observed.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
observed.description: The value the resume observed; absent when none was recorded.

stored.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
stored.description: The value the manifest stored; absent when none was recorded.

Digest.description: A content digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

DigestRef.description: A digest and the kind of thing it identifies: a catalog snapshot or an input.

kind.description: What the digest identifies, as a plain name.

EnvironmentRef.description: The lock digest of a plug-in environment, with the plug-in as `name@version`.

lock_digest.description: The digest of the plug-in's lock file.

FieldPath.description: A dotted path to a field: one or more segments joined by `.`, each a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or `_`.

GitCommit.description: A git commit: 40 or 64 lowercase hex digits.

HarnessIdentity.description: The harness a run used, as it identified itself: its name, its version and, when one drove it, the driver as `name@version`.

driver.description: The driver that ran the harness, as `name@version`.

ImportRecord.description: How an imported run was read: the format label, the base commit, the legacy integrity block, the source files and the outcome files written.

base_commit.description: The commit of the legacy repository the run was read at.

format.description: The label of the legacy format, as `name@token`.

legacy_integrity.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
legacy_integrity.description: The legacy integrity block as it was written; any JSON value except `null`.

requests.description: The outcome files the import wrote.

sources.description: The files the import read, each stored as a blob.

ImportSource.description: A file the import read, kept as a blob: its run-relative path and its `sha256`.

path.description: The run-relative path of the file in the legacy run.

sha256.description: The digest of the file's bytes.

ImportedRequest.description: An outcome file the import wrote, found by its evaluator and request.

request.description: The request id of the outcome file.

Integrity.description: Whether a run counts: `valid`, or `invalid` with the reason it does not.

oneOf.description: The run does not count, and the reason says why.

InvalidReason.description: Why a run is invalid: a cause that is not the arm's doing.

oneOf.description: The gateway or the provider failed.
The job budget stopped the run.
The supervisor was lost while the run ran.
A secret or ground truth reached the run's isolation boundary.
The collection of the run's files failed.
A reader of the run's output failed.
The format of the run's output is not one a reader knows.

JobId.description: A job id: a `UUIDv7` in lowercase hyphenated form.

MeasuredValue.description: A value together with its source, written as an object with the string `path`, the JSON `value` and the object `source`.

path.description: The dotted path of the field.

value.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.

Name.description: A plain name, such as that of a harness, a reader, a plug-in or a treatment: non-empty, with neither `@` nor white space.

NameToken.description: A catalog provider reference, `name@token`, split at the last `@`: the name is non-empty and holds neither `@` nor white space, and the token matches `[0-9A-Za-z.+-]+`.

NameVersion.$comment: The major, minor and patch numbers each fit in 64 bits; the parser enforces it.
NameVersion.description: An evaluator or instrument reference, `name@version`, split at the last `@`: the name is non-empty and holds neither `@` nor white space, and the version is `SemVer` 2.0.

RelPath.description: A run-relative POSIX path: non-empty, with no leading `/`, no empty segment, no `.` or `..` segment, no NUL and no `\`.

RequestId.description: A request id: a `UUIDv7` in lowercase hyphenated form.

ResolvedValue.description: A value resolved for a field, written as an object with the string `path` and, unless the source system did not record it, the JSON `value`.

path.description: The dotted path of the field the value belongs to.

value.$comment: Integers lie within ±(2^53 - 1); JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a larger one.
value.description: The resolved value; absent when the source system did not record one.

RunKey.description: The identity of one run: the digest of its cell, and its replicate and attempt numbers, both counted from 1.

attempt.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.

cell.description: The digest of the cell the run belongs to.

replicate.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.

SecretName.description: An environment-variable name: an uppercase ASCII letter or `_`, then uppercase letters, digits or `_`.

SecretPresence.description: Whether a secret the run needs was present in the environment, by name; the value is never written.

name.description: The name of the environment variable.

SourceEntry.description: The source of the value of one field, written as an object with the string `path` and the object `source`.

path.description: The dotted path of the field.

source.description: Where the field's value came from.

Timestamp.$comment: The pattern states the lexical form; a date or time that names no instant, such as month 13, and a fraction of more than nine digits are refused by the parser.
Timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp with an uppercase `T` and an explicit offset, `Z` or `±HH:MM`.

TreatmentRef.description: The treatment an experiment applies: a name, and the tag and commit it is pinned to.

commit.description: The commit the treatment is pinned to.

tag.description: The tag the treatment is pinned to, as its source names it.

ValueSource.description: Where a resolved value came from: an object whose `kind` names the source, with `step` for `derived` and `file` for `imported`.

oneOf.description: An argument given on the command line or in a request.
A value a preflight step derived, under the key `step`.

step.description: The preflight step that derived the value, as `name@token`.

oneOf.description: A value read from a legacy run, under the key `file`.

file.description: The run-relative file the value was read from.

oneOf.description: A value the source system did not record; it carries no value and nothing guesses one.

description: A run's manifest: what it was, what it resolved and how it ended, with the version marker `run-manifest/1` in `schema`.

deviations.description: The re-checked values a forced resume accepted.

experiment.description: The digest of the experiment's sorted cell digests.

factors.description: The field paths that vary across the experiment's cells.

import.description: How an imported run was read.

measured.description: The values observed during the run, with the run's end under `run.ended_by` and `run.exit`.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `run-manifest/1`.

secrets.description: The secrets the run needed and whether each was present; never their values.

sources.$comment: Each path of `comparable.values` has exactly one entry, and each of `harness`, `treatment` and the non-empty lists `snapshots`, `inputs` and `environments` has an entry at the root path or at a path under it; no other path appears and no path repeats. JSON Schema cannot state this, and the Rust reader refuses a list that differs.
sources.description: Where each value came from: one entry per value, and one or more entries under each typed root the cell holds; never an entry for a setting.

title: RunManifest
